$comment: Runtime witness for shipped <ctype.h> (shippedLibs/ctype.json) on every hosted format, baseline AND the `release` shippedPipeline arm. WHY: ctype is the one shipped surface whose answers are LOCALE-DEPENDENT (each classifier reads the CRT's locale table), and a runtime whose locale data is not live returns a WRONG ANSWER rather than faulting — a silent-miscompile class. Before this example the corpus had NO ctype.h user, so nothing guarded it. Added by the pe CRT migration msvcrt.dll -> ucrtbase.dll (D-FFI-PE-CRT-UCRT-MIGRATION Phase 1, which flips ctype.json first); Phase 0 proved empirically that ucrtbase's locale data self-initializes on DLL-attach under DSS's startup-less pe entry, and this example is the permanent per-target regression guard for that finding. BOTH POLARITIES are asserted: an unpopulated table answers 0 for everything (caught by the positive checks) while a wrong mask answers nonzero for everything (caught ONLY by the negative checks) — testing one direction would leave the other failure mode invisible. ANTI-FOLD: every argument rides a MUTABLE global (the c11_atomic / c99_tgmath precedent) rather than a literal — DSS does not elide an extern call today regardless, but a literal argument is precisely what would let a future const-fold or builtin-recognition pass answer isalpha('A') at COMPILE time, at which point the release arm would stop exercising the runtime's locale table and this example would quietly become a tautology. Each predicate has its own exit code (60..83) so a regression names the exact classifier instead of just 'not 42'. exit = 42.
